response.justification: Bogdan is a Staff-level engineer with a strong software craftsmanship background. His most recent role is a direct match, involving AI-agent infrastructure, agentic workflows, and Model Context Protocol (MCP). While he does not have the requested 8 years of specific AI experience, his deep technical skills, seniority, and recent, highly relevant pivot into the exact domain of the role make him a compelling candidate to interview. The interview should focus on the depth and breadth of his recent AI work.
strengths: Current role directly involves building AI-agent infrastructure and agentic workflows, including the specified Model Context Protocol (MCP).
Holds a "Staff" title and demonstrates strong software engineering principles and mentorship experience through workshops and open-source contributions.
Extensive experience with cloud (AWS CDK), high-throughput data systems, and a variety of programming languages (TypeScript, DLang, Java).
concerns: Lacks the requested "minimum 8 years building... production-grade AI solutions"; most experience is in general software engineering with a very recent pivot to AI.
No explicit mention of experience with vector databases or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, which are required qualifications.
Python, a primary language for the GenAI ecosystem, is not listed as a skill, though TypeScript experience is strong.
